cohort: The study included 415 neonates admitted to referral hospitals in Eastern Ethiopia with sepsis between January 1, 2021, and December 31, 2021.
finding: Low birthweight, maternal age >= 35 years, low fifth-minute Apgar score, and late initiation of breastfeeding were identified as independent predictors of mortality among neonates with sepsis.
followup_time: Until discharge or death; median time to death for those who died was 14 days, occurring within the neonatal period.
